butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **104:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Söz, yükseltilmiş ilahî isim ve rahmet çerçevesi içinde başlar. butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **104:1.** وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ — Birincil okuma: Vay, herkesi diliyle ve gizli işaretiyle inciten alışkanlık sahibinedir. parent_channels.name: Denigration, Force, and Breaking

subchannels.name: Speech as Compressed Injury
subchannels.scene_or_process: An aggressor compresses fault-finding into utterance, gesture, and repeated attack until another person's standing is blunted.
subchannels.active_motifs: fault-finding and covert disparagement (`ل م ز:B001/m01`); denigrating assault (`ه م ز:B004/m01`); pressure-shaped articulation (`ه م ز:B002/m01`); blunted tongue or perception (`ك ل ل:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:1 كُلِّ (`ك ل ل`), هُمَزَةٍ (`ه م ز`), and لُّمَزَةٍ (`ل م ز`)
subchannels.synthesis: The speech act is figured as pressure rather than neutral description. Articulation itself is compressed, the target is persistently probed for defects, and the resulting social injury resembles an edge or faculty made dull.

subchannels.name: Hand Pressure, Prodding, and Casting
subchannels.scene_or_process: Force gathers in the hand, becomes a squeeze or thrust, and ends by displacing its object.
subchannels.active_motifs: squeezing in the hand (`ه م ز:B001/m01`); prodding impulse (`ه م ز:B003/m01`); bodily push or blow (`ل م ز:B002/m01`); clenched fist (`ج م ع:B005/m01`); physical casting (`ن ب ذ:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering and pressure converge in the clenched hand. The hand compresses, the prod transfers force, and the pushed object is finally thrown away, giving the surface casting a tactile prehistory.

subchannels.name: Crushing by Coalesced Mass
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate bodies gather momentum, overrun what lies before them, and leave brittle matter fragmented.
subchannels.active_motifs: brittle fracture and fragmentation (`ح ط م:B001/m01`); trampling herd or ravaging mass (`ح ط م:B006/m01`); coalesced charging force (`ج م ع:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Crushing is not only a single impact. It can be the cumulative force of a herd, flood-like movement, or gathered charge whose parts become one destructive mass and reduce resistant material to fragments.

subchannels.name: Harsh Driving and Exhaustion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A harsh driver forces living bodies onward until movement and faculties lose their edge.
subchannels.active_motifs: violent herding or driving (`ح ط م:B004/m01`); exhaustion of walker, mount, wind, or faculty (`ك ل ل:B001/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: The driver is named through the damage he causes: bodies are crowded and driven without relief, while motion, sight, hearing, or cutting power becomes spent and dull.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Concentrated pressure crosses from speech and gesture into propulsion, forced movement, and the loss of bodily or material integrity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:1 هُمَزَةٍ and لُّمَزَةٍ enact social injury, while 104:4-5 يُنۢبَذَ and ٱلْحُطَمَةِ turn pressure into casting and crushing.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same force pattern extends through compressed articulation, a clenched palm, a prod or bow impulse, a charging mass, and an exhausted driven animal.

parent_channels.name: Accumulation, Measure, and Claimed Permanence

subchannels.name: Hoarding, Calculation, and False Permanence
subchannels.scene_or_process: Property is gathered and repeatedly counted, then mentally promoted from a reserve into a guarantor of lasting existence.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering dispersed holdings (`ج م ع:B001/m01`); numerical enumeration (`ع د د:B001/m01`); accumulated property (`م و ل:B001/m01`); accounting and calculation (`ح س ب:B001/m01`); supposition (`ح س ب:B002/m01`); enduring permanence (`خ ل د:B001/m01`); devotion and object-making (`ء ل ه:B001/m01`); transient worldly goods (`ح ط م:B009/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`), مَالًا (`م و ل`), and عَدَّدَهُ (`ع د د`); 104:3 يَحْسَبُ (`ح س ب`), مَالَهُ (`م و ل`), and أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 ٱللَّهِ (`ء ل ه`)
subchannels.synthesis: Counting converts possessions into an apparently closed system of security. The devotional branch sharpens the relation: wealth can be treated as an object of ultimate reliance, yet the crushing branch recasts its display and ornament as passing debris.

subchannels.name: Totality and Full Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parts are enclosed in a whole until nothing appears absent and the containing space is filled to capacity.
subchannels.active_motifs: complete and undiminished whole (`ج م ع:B009/m01`); all-inclusive totality (`ك ل ل:B003/m01`); capacity filled to its limit (`ط ل ع:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering reaches a terminal state in which the object is intact, the parts are comprehensively included, and the available space is full. The channel turns counting from an open sequence into bounded completeness.

subchannels.name: Prepared Reserves and Material Aid
subchannels.scene_or_process: Supplies are measured, stored, and made ready so they can sustain a person, household, or force when need arrives.
subchannels.active_motifs: prepared equipment and reserves (`ع د د:B002/m01`); reinforcements and material aid (`م د د:B002/m01`); sufficient provision (`ح س ب:B003/m01`); measured allotment (`م د د:B006/m01`); small residual portion (`ن ب ذ:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Enumeration becomes logistics: one prepares an outfit, reserve, weapon, food supply, or reinforcement, then portions it by measure. The tiny remainder and the sufficient store establish the lower and upper bounds of usable provision.

subchannels.name: Counted Terms and Recurring Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time is divided into obligatory intervals, recurring appointments, and prolonged terms.
subchannels.active_motifs: prescribed waiting span (`ع د د:B003/m01`); recurrent appointed time (`ع د د:B005/m01`); extended term or respite (`م د د:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Numbering governs duration as well as possessions. A span can be counted because it imposes waiting, returns on schedule, or is deliberately prolonged, making time itself an administered quantity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Gathered quantities are counted, provisioned, extended, and treated as though numerical control could secure adequacy or duration.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:2 جَمَعَ مَالًا وَعَدَّدَهُ and 104:3 يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُ أَخْلَدَهُ explicitly join accumulation, enumeration, estimation, wealth, and imagined permanence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Quantity expands into total capacity, reserve logistics, calendrical spans, devotional fixation on property, and the return of worldly goods to breakable debris.

parent_channels.name: Combustion, Heat, and Consumption

subchannels.name: Ignition, Fuel, Hearth, and Cooking
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fuel is placed at a hearth, rapidly ignited, and used to heat, roast, or bake food before digestion completes the transformation.
subchannels.active_motifs: ignition and flame (`و ق د:B001/m01`); combustible fuel (`و ق د:B002/m01`); hearth or fire-place (`و ق د:B003/m01`); rapid kindling (`و ق د:B005/m01`); visible fire (`ن و ر:B002/m01`); heat and fire (`ف ء د:B001/m01`); roasting or baking (`ف ء د:B001/m02`); hearth and skewer implements (`ف ء د:B001/m03`); large cooking vessel (`ج م ع:B012/m01`); digestive action (`ح ط م:B008/m02`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 نَارُ (`ن و ر`) and ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ (`و ق د`); 104:7 ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ (`ف ء د`)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical branches assemble a complete combustion system: material fuel, a bounded hearth, ignition, flame, vessel, food, and digestive breakdown. External fire and internal digestion become parallel mechanisms for reducing and transforming matter.

subchannels.name: The Heart as an Interior Fire
subchannels.scene_or_process: Thought lodges in the heart, heat gathers there, and rapid ignition becomes ardor, anger, or social conflict.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart as inward heat (`ف ء د:B002/m01`); thought lodged in the mind or heart (`خ ل د:B004/m01`); emotional ardor, anger, or war (`و ق د:B005/m02`); anger's domination (`ع م د:B015/m01`); feud between groups (`ن و ر:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The heart is not merely reached by fire; it already has a lexical capacity for inner burning. A settled thought can kindle into fervor, anger, and conflict, so psychological fixation and social hostility reproduce the dynamics of combustion.

subchannels.name: Gluttony and Emesis
subchannels.scene_or_process: Appetite consumes beyond restraint until what entered the body rises back out.
subchannels.active_motifs: voracious eater (`ح ط م:B008/m01`); rising vomit (`ط ل ع:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Consumption first resembles a fire that breaks food down, then reverses direction as the stomach expels what it could not contain. Rising changes from emergence into emesis.

subchannels.name: Summer Heat and Drought
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sustained seasonal heat dries the environment until a severe year breaks people, animals, and property.
subchannels.active_motifs: peak summer heat (`و ق د:B004/m01`); destructive drought-year (`ح ط م:B003/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:6 ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ (`و ق د`)
subchannels.synthesis: Combustion expands to climate: heat becomes a season, the season becomes drought, and drought performs the same breaking action on living communities that impact performs on brittle matter.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material is fed into heat, transformed by combustion or digestion, and carried from an external fire into bodily and emotional interiors.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:6 نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ names fire and ignition, and 104:7 تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ carries that process into the hearts.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The fire scene includes fuel, hearth, cooking vessel, digestive action, inward anger, appetite, vomiting, summer heat, and drought.

parent_channels.name: Enclosure and Structural Support

subchannels.name: Sealed Doorway
subchannels.scene_or_process: A doorway is brought shut and made fast so passage is no longer available.
subchannels.active_motifs: firmly closed door (`و ص د:B001/m01`); doorway attached to a dwelling (`و ص د:B002/m02`); sealing and shutting (`ء ص د:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:8 مُّؤْصَدَةٌ (`و ص د`); no separate surface occurrence for `ء ص د`
subchannels.synthesis: Object and action coincide: the doorway marks the access point, while closing pressure converts it into an impassable boundary. The alternate closure branch intensifies the sense of something clamped over its contents.

subchannels.name: Courtyard, Stone Pen, and Mountain Recess
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded exterior space gathers occupants or livestock within a forecourt, stone enclosure, or recess between mountains.
subchannels.active_motifs: house forecourt (`و ص د:B002/m01`); mountain stone pen (`و ص د:B003/m01`); encompassing enclosure (`ء ص د:B002/m01`); courtyard or open fore-space (`ء ص د:B004/m01`); place between mountains (`ء ص د:B005/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:8 مُّؤْصَدَةٌ (`و ص د`); no separate surface occurrence for `ء ص د`
subchannels.synthesis: Closure acquires a spatial interior. The house forecourt, livestock pen, and mountain recess all use surrounding edges to hold what lies within, even when the bounded space remains open above.

subchannels.name: Canopy and Bodily Restraint
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible enclosure surrounds a body either protectively as a canopy or coercively as a fetter.
subchannels.active_motifs: tent-like protective cover (`ك ل ل:B006/m01`); hand-to-neck restraint (`ج م ع:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Both objects gather the body into a restricted volume. The canopy excludes insects and exposure, whereas the fetter removes freedom of movement, creating a sharp protective-versus-punitive reversal.

subchannels.name: Columns, Props, and Extended Frameworks
subchannels.scene_or_process: Upright members support a structure, establish its central load path, and continue lengthwise into an extended framework.
subchannels.active_motifs: propping and support (`ع م د:B002/m01`); column or pillar (`ع م د:B003/m01`); load-bearing core (`ع م د:B007/m01`); lengthwise extension (`م د د:B001/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:9 عَمَدٍ (`ع م د`) and مُّمَدَّدَةٍ (`م د د`)
subchannels.synthesis: A prop receives weight, the column regularizes that support, and extension distributes it through space. The surface pair therefore contains both the vertical member and the operation that carries its reach onward.

subchannels.name: Crowded Sacred Gathering Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: People converge at a sacred gathering place whose wall or precinct becomes compressed by crowding.
subchannels.active_motifs: crowded or broken sanctuary precinct (`ح ط م:B007/m01`); pilgrimage gathering place or day (`ج م ع:B004/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering supplies the human convergence, while the sanctuary branch gives it a built boundary vulnerable to pressure and breakage. Social assembly and architectural compression occupy one scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Space is bounded by doors, yards, pens, covers, restraints, walls, and load-bearing members that determine what remains inside and what can stand.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:8 مُّؤْصَدَةٌ establishes closure, while 104:9 عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ supplies columns and extension.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The closed structure ranges from a sealed doorway to a mountain livestock pen, a bodily canopy, a hand-to-neck fetter, and a crowded sanctuary.

parent_channels.name: Collective Cohesion and Social Continuity

subchannels.name: Assembly and Alliance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed people gather at a common place, become a recognized group, and coordinate around a shared undertaking.
subchannels.active_motifs: assembled group or mixed collective (`ج م ع:B002/m01`); civic gathering place or summons (`ج م ع:B004/m01`); alliance or collusion (`ج م ع:B013/m01`); grouped bodies (`ك ل ل:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Collection becomes social organization when a place or summons brings people together and alliance gives the group a common direction. The resulting whole is more than proximity: its members act in concert.

subchannels.name: Tent Community and Comparative Standing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mobile tent community distinguishes households and persons by inherited standing, visible qualities, and comparison with peers.
subchannels.active_motifs: socially counted prestige (`ح س ب:B004/m01`); people of tents and poles (`ع م د:B004/m01`); peer, counterpart, or allotted share (`ع د د:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The tent pole supplies a social setting as well as a structure. Within it, standing is something reckoned from ancestry, conduct, generosity, or wealth and negotiated by comparison with others.

subchannels.name: Collateral Kin and Inherited Standing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A death activates lateral kinship, and inherited standing identifies which relations count when direct parent-child continuity is absent.
subchannels.active_motifs: collateral kin and inheritance (`ك ل ل:B004/m01`); ancestral standing (`ح س ب:B004/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Social accounting reaches into genealogy. When the direct line is missing, lateral relations become operative, while ancestry supplies the remembered standing through which the family locates itself.

subchannels.name: Union, Pregnancy, and Withheld Consummation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sexual union creates reproductive continuity, while pregnancy, virginity, or an unconsummated marriage marks whether that connection has taken effect.
subchannels.active_motifs: sexual union (`ج م ع:B006/m01`); retained pregnancy (`ج م ع:B007/m01`); untouched spouse or virgin state (`ج م ع:B007/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering becomes the joining of bodies and the continuity of generations. The same lexical container also records suspended union: a spouse remains untouched, or pregnancy remains held within the body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Individuals become a durable social body through assembly, alliance, rank, kinship, and reproductive connection.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 104:1 كُلِّ, 104:2 جَمَعَ and عَدَّدَهُ, 104:3 يَحْسَبُ, and 104:9 عَمَدٍ provide the lexical anchors for groups, gathering, comparison, standing, and communal reliance.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Collective cohesion ranges from public assembly and strategic alliance to tent-based status, collateral inheritance, sexual union, pregnancy, and the suspended state of an unconsummated marriage.

parent_channels.name: Emergence, Visibility, and Growth

subchannels.name: Luminary Rise and Guiding Light
subchannels.scene_or_process: A luminary rises, spreads light, and becomes a visible marker by which travelers orient themselves.
subchannels.active_motifs: rising sun, dawn, moon, or star (`ط ل ع:B001/m01`); illumination (`ن و ر:B001/m01`); beacon or boundary marker (`ن و ر:B005/m01`); cloud-flash or lightning (`ك ل ل:B011/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Rise creates visibility, light extends it, and a beacon stabilizes it into orientation. The momentary lightning flash is the compressed counterpart of the enduring guide.

subchannels.name: Sprouting, Flowering, and Close-Rooted Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Plants emerge from hidden growth, flower, and thicken into a closely rooted stand.
subchannels.active_motifs: emerging palm spathe or crop (`ط ل ع:B005/m01`); blossom (`ن و ر:B004/m01`); close-rooted vegetation (`و ص د:B004/m01`); mixed seed-grown date palm (`ج م ع:B011/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Emergence proceeds from first visible growth to flower and then to a dense stand whose roots draw near one another. The unnamed mixed palm adds generative variety to the same cultivated scene.

subchannels.name: Arrival, Peeking, and Visible Appearance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A figure approaches or suddenly appears, looks out from concealment, and withdraws when seen.
subchannels.active_motifs: appearing arrival or incursion (`ط ل ع:B002/m01`); curious peeking and hiding (`ط ل ع:B008/m01`); visible countenance (`ط ل ع:B009/m01`); shy or startled flight (`ن و ر:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Visibility is unstable: an arrival breaks into view, a face presents itself, and a curious observer alternates between looking and concealment. Shy flight turns appearance into immediate retreat.

subchannels.name: Ascent, Vantage, and Prominence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person or object climbs to an overlooking position and becomes conspicuous through height.
subchannels.active_motifs: ascent and overlooking access (`ط ل ع:B006/m01`); protruding height (`ط ل ع:B012/m01`); lofty visible structure (`ع م د:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Ascent supplies the route, the overlook supplies perspective, and height turns the elevated object into a landmark. The channel joins movement upward with the state of standing above one's surroundings.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Something hidden or low comes into view by rising, sprouting, approaching, peeking, flashing, or occupying a vantage point.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 104:6 نَارُ supplies visible light and 104:7 تَطَّلِعُ supplies upward emergence and disclosure.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The invariant links luminaries, beacons, lightning, palms, flowers, shy peeking, sudden arrival, mountain ascent, and conspicuous height.

parent_channels.name: Inquiry, Targeting, and Deliberate Action

subchannels.name: Knowing, Testing, and Disclosure
subchannels.scene_or_process: An unknown matter is investigated, tested, learned, and disclosed to another observer.
subchannels.active_motifs: knowing a matter (`د ر ي:B001/m01`); informing another (`د ر ي:B001/m02`); seeking and testing news (`ح س ب:B010/m01`); inspecting or revealing hidden affairs (`ط ل ع:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Inquiry moves from uncertain report to tested knowledge, then from private discovery to disclosure. Looking into a hidden matter and causing another to know it are consecutive roles in one epistemic process.

subchannels.name: Deliberation and Accountable Leadership
subchannels.scene_or_process: A group consolidates its judgment, an overseer examines conduct, and a relied-upon leader carries the decision.
subchannels.active_motifs: resolved collective judgment (`ج م ع:B003/m01`); practical oversight and accountability (`ح س ب:B006/m01`); relied-upon leader (`ع م د:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Distributed opinions are gathered into resolve, oversight tests the resulting conduct, and leadership supplies the person on whom implementation rests. Cognition becomes administration.

subchannels.name: Reconnaissance and Deliberate Raid
subchannels.scene_or_process: Scouts gain sight of an opponent so a force can choose and deliberately approach its target.
subchannels.active_motifs: reconnaissance party (`ط ل ع:B004/m01`); purposeful targeting or raid (`د ر ي:B002/m01`); deliberate intent (`ع م د:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scout supplies information, intent fixes the objective, and the raid converts knowledge into directed movement. Seeing and striking are ordered stages rather than unrelated acts.

subchannels.name: Concealed Hunt and Projectile Flight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hunter approaches under cover, aims a pointed implement, releases a force-driven projectile, and either reaches the heart or overshoots the mark.
subchannels.active_motifs: concealed stalking (`د ر ي:B003/m01`); pointed horn or implement (`د ر ي:B004/m01`); bow-driven impulse (`ه م ز:B003/m02`); arrow overshooting its target (`ط ل ع:B010/m01`); strike to the heart (`ف ء د:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment manages distance, the pointed tool and bow concentrate force, and the heart defines the intended endpoint. Overshooting preserves the same trajectory while reversing its outcome.

subchannels.name: Declared Conflict and Tokenized Exchange
subchannels.scene_or_process: Throwing an object or declaration changes a social relation by openly ending a pact or making a sale binding.
subchannels.active_motifs: treaty renunciation and open confrontation (`ن ب ذ:B002/m01`); sale concluded by thrown token or goods (`ن ب ذ:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Casting becomes a formal sign rather than disposal. In one case it returns a pact and opens conflict; in the other it transfers goods and closes a transaction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Knowledge is sought or assembled, converted into intention, and then directed toward governance, reconnaissance, hunting, conflict, or formal exchange.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:5 أَدْرَىٰكَ foregrounds knowing, 104:7 تَطَّلِعُ foregrounds inspection, and 104:9 عَمَدٍ carries the lexical extension into deliberate intent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Epistemic inquiry develops into administrative oversight, scouting, a concealed hunt, projectile mechanics, treaty renunciation, and sale by thrown token.

parent_channels.name: Material Flow and Replenishment

subchannels.name: Wells, Feeding Waters, and Earthworks
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water collects in a durable source, one flow replenishes another, and a dam redirects or holds the current against packed earth.
subchannels.active_motifs: perennial well or collected water (`ع د د:B004/m01`); water feeding another watercourse (`م د د:B003/m01`); dam across a stream (`ع م د:B013/m01`); rain-packed soil (`ع م د:B010/m01`); loose excavated earth (`ن ب ذ:B009/m02`); coalesced flood momentum (`ج م ع:B010/m02`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`) and عَدَّدَهُ (`ع د د`); 104:4 يُنۢبَذَ (`ن ب ذ`); 104:9 عَمَدٍ (`ع م د`) and مُّمَدَّدَةٍ (`م د د`)
subchannels.synthesis: The channel supplies source, flow, barrier, and construction material. Water gathers and extends itself through tributary feeding, while packed and excavated earth reshape that movement into a retained pool or redirected course.

subchannels.name: Steeped Drink and Enriched Animal Water
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dry ingredient is cast into water and left to infuse, producing a drink or nutritive mixture.
subchannels.active_motifs: fruit steeped in a vessel (`ن ب ذ:B006/m01`); water enriched with meal or seed for animals (`م د د:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Casting initiates mixture rather than rejection. Water receives fruit, flour, seed, or sesame, and the added substance extends plain liquid into a prepared drink or feed.

subchannels.name: Ink Supply from Inkwell to Pen
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inkwell is replenished, holds a writing medium, and yields that medium to a pen.
subchannels.active_motifs: ink medium (`م د د:B005/m01`); replenished inkwell (`م د د:B005/m02`); pen drawing its supply (`م د د:B005/m03`)
subchannels.synthesis: Extension is material and sequential: liquid is added to the inkwell, retained there, and drawn onward by the pen. Writing becomes a controlled flow system in miniature.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A material moves through a channel or container to replenish, mix with, or extend another material system.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 104:2 جَمَعَ and عَدَّدَهُ, 104:4 يُنۢبَذَ, and 104:9 عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ anchor gathering, stored water, added material, dams, and extension.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same replenishment mechanism governs rivers and wells, earth dams, steeped fruit drink, enriched animal water, and ink drawn from an inkwell into a pen.

parent_channels.name: Bodily Integrity and Attrition

subchannels.name: Heart Ailment, Weakness, and Crushing Pain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Injury or disease reaches the heart, spreads through the chest, and leaves the person weak, fearful, or overwhelmed by pain.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart ailment (`ف ء د:B003/m02`); weak or absent-hearted state (`ف ء د:B004/m01`); crushing grief, pain, or illness (`ع م د:B008/m01`); chest as bodily enclosure (`ك ل ل:B007/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The chest locates the vulnerable interior, the heart receives disease, and crushing pain changes an organ-level injury into a whole-person state of weakness or fear.

subchannels.name: Aging, Pressure Wound, and Suppuration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Age or repeated pressure weakens a body, damages tissue beneath an intact surface, and produces swelling or pus.
subchannels.active_motifs: senescence and emaciation (`ح ط م:B005/m01`); saddle or pressure wound (`ع م د:B009/m01`); accumulating wound discharge (`م د د:B007/m01`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ/ٱلْحُطَمَةُ (`ح ط م`); 104:9 عَمَدٍ (`ع م د`) and مُّمَدَّدَةٍ (`م د د`)
subchannels.synthesis: Attrition can be gradual rather than explosive. A body loses strength with age, sustained pressure crushes tissue under the skin, and the wound extends internally as swelling and discharge.

subchannels.name: Vigor and Undiminished Form
subchannels.scene_or_process: A youthful or stout body retains fullness, strength, and all of its parts.
subchannels.active_motifs: vigorous full-bodied youth (`ع م د:B011/m01`); stout compact physique (`ك ل ل:B008/m01`); intact body without loss (`ج م ع:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Integrity is rendered positively as compact strength, bodily fullness, and the absence of missing parts. This is the bodily opposite of the crushed, emaciated, or suppurating state.

subchannels.name: Mottled Color and Skin Affliction
subchannels.scene_or_process: White, red, gray, or patchy coloration becomes a visible bodily state and may shade into a skin disorder.
subchannels.active_motifs: mottled skin or hair coloration (`ح س ب:B009/m01`); disease-like discoloration (`ح س ب:B009/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reckoning shifts into visible pattern: colors are distributed across skin, hair, or hide, and the same appearance can be read as ordinary coloration or bodily affliction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies move between intact strength and loss of integrity through pain, heart disease, aging, pressure wounds, suppuration, or altered skin.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 104:1 كُلِّ, 104:3 يَحْسَبُ, 104:4-5 ٱلْحُطَمَةِ, 104:7 ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ, and 104:9 عَمَدٍ مُّمَدَّدَةٍ anchor faculties, bodily estimation, breaking, heart, pain, and wound extension.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The body appears as chest and heart, aged mount, swollen saddle wound, vigorous youth, intact animal, and skin whose color shades into disease.

parent_channels.name: Adornment and Surface Presentation

subchannels.name: Garment and Attached Jewelry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clothing covers the body while ornaments remain attached at the ear or wrist as durable visible additions.
subchannels.active_motifs: small undergarment (`ء ص د:B003/m01`); attached earrings or bracelets (`خ ل د:B003/m01`); garments gathered over the body (`ج م ع:B009/m02`)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 104:2 جَمَعَ (`ج م ع`); 104:3 أَخْلَدَهُ (`خ ل د`); no separate surface occurrence for `ء ص د`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering and attachment form two layers of presentation. Garments gather around the body, while jewelry remains fixed to selected points and turns persistence into ornament.

subchannels.name: Combing, Kohl, and Depilation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A pointed grooming tool orders the hair, dark pigment defines the eye or skin, and a preparation removes unwanted hair.
subchannels.active_motifs: hair-combing tool (`د ر ي:B004/m02`); soot used as kohl (`ن و ر:B008/m01`); depilatory preparation (`ن و ر:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Grooming combines shaping, adding pigment, and removing material. The pointed comb, smoke-derived cosmetic, and depilatory preparation operate on different surfaces but share the work of deliberate bodily presentation.

subchannels.name: Fire-Made Marks
subchannels.scene_or_process: Heat and smoke leave a durable sign on skin or hide.
subchannels.active_motifs: livestock brand made by fire (`ن و ر:B002/m02`); tattoo pigment from smoke (`ن و ر:B008/m02`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fire produces more than light and destruction. Applied to a surface, it becomes an identifying brand; reduced to smoke pigment, it becomes an inserted bodily mark.

subchannels.name: Circlet, Smile, and Sparkle
subchannels.scene_or_process: An encircling ornament frames a visible subject, while teeth or a polished object flash within the viewer's field.
subchannels.active_motifs: crown, halo, or encircling wreath (`ك ل ل:B005/m01`); tooth-revealing smile (`ك ل ل:B011/m01`); fire-like glitter (`و ق د:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The circlet supplies stable framing and the smile or glitter supplies momentary brilliance. Encirclement and flash work together to make a person, place, or object visually prominent.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A visible surface is dressed, encircled, groomed, colored, marked, or made to flash.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 104:1 كُلِّ, 104:2 جَمَعَ, 104:3 أَخْلَدَهُ, 104:5 أَدْرَىٰكَ, 104:6 نَارُ and ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ, and 104:7 تَطَّلِعُ provide the lexical anchors for covering, attached ornament, grooming tools, pigment, branding, and display.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Presentation includes a child's undergarment, earrings and bracelets, combing, kohl, depilation, tattoo smoke, livestock branding, crowns, smiles, and gemstone-like sparkle.

parent_channels.name: Attachment, Exclusion, and Place

subchannels.name: Clinging and Continued Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person adheres to a place or companion, settles there, and remains.
subchannels.active_motifs: clinging, resting, or dwelling (`خ ل د:B002/m01`); continued adherence or residence (`ع م د:B014/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Attachment is both relational and spatial. One leans toward a person or place, then converts that inclination into sustained residence.

subchannels.name: Withdrawal to the Side
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person leaves the center of activity and takes up a position at the side.
subchannels.active_motifs: moving or sitting apart (`ن ب ذ:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Casting is internalized as self-placement: instead of being thrown away by another person, the person withdraws and occupies a marginal location.

subchannels.name: Cast-Off Dependents
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dependent person or animal is rejected, left exposed, and made reliant on whoever receives or sustains it.
subchannels.active_motifs: rejection from consideration (`ن ب ذ:B001/m02`); abandoned child (`ن ب ذ:B007/m01`); neglected ewe (`ن ب ذ:B009/m01`); dependent, burden, or orphan (`ك ل ل:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Expulsion becomes a social condition. The foundling, neglected animal, orphan, or burden lacks a secure center and survives only by entering another person's care.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons and objects are positioned by clinging to a place, moving aside, or being cast beyond a social or spatial center.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:3 أَخْلَدَهُ supplies adhesion and settledness, 104:4 يُنۢبَذَ supplies expulsion, and 104:9 عَمَدٍ supplies continued adherence.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Spatial placement becomes a social relation encompassing residence, withdrawal, foundlings, dependents, and neglected animals.

parent_channels.name: Calamity Voiced as Doom and Lament

subchannels.name: Pronouncement of Ruin
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker declares that destruction, punishment, or evil has fallen upon its addressee.
subchannels.active_motifs: doom and ruin formula (`و ي ل:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The utterance does not merely describe danger; it performs a judgment by placing the addressee under ruin and punishment.

subchannels.name: Lament, Disgrace, and Invocation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sufferer turns calamity inward as a cry of shame or distress and may invoke the divine name within that cry.
subchannels.active_motifs: personal lament and disgrace (`و ي ل:B002/m01`); divine name in invocation or oath (`ء ل ه:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The external sentence of doom becomes a first-person lament. Invocation gives that cry an addressee and intensifies the movement from public calamity to personally voiced distress.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Calamity is made present through speech, either as a pronouncement over another or as a first-person cry of disgrace and distress.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 104:1 وَيْلٌ voices doom, while 104:6 ٱللَّهِ supplies the divine name that can enter oath, appeal, or lament.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A compact doom formula unfolds into personal lament, public disgrace, and invocation.

parent_channels.name: S1. Cushioned Seating
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A small cushion is thrown down, arranged, and used to seat or support a person.
parent_channels.active_motifs: small supporting cushion (`ح س ب:B008/m01`); floor cushion placed for sitting (`ن ب ذ:B008/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Throwing is constructive here: the cushion is cast onto the ground precisely so it can receive a seated body, while the smaller pillow supplies localized support.

parent_channels.name: S2. Blind Burrowing Animal
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A small blind, mouse-like animal inhabits a concealed ground-level environment.
parent_channels.synthesis: The branch forms a complete concrete animal image centered on blindness, resemblance to a mouse, and hidden low movement.
